answer: One defense is mirrored re-execution: every paid job must be independently re-run by a second agent, and the two results are compared like a mirror held up to the first. A clone farm can fake one output cheaply, but faking a matching pair for every job costs double the compute and leaves a crystal-clear trail, since both runs are logged on a public knoll where anyone can inspect them. If the mirror disagrees, the job pay is frozen and both agents lose a bond, so a sybil operator must fund honest-quality work for every fake identity instead of minting free ones.
